entries.name: --ec-backdrop-opacity
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the opacity of the overlay behind the settings drawer (0.4 light, 0.6 dark) is a platform value the book does not set. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-border-status-bar
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the status bar border is transparent in light and the border colour in dark, and the book defines no hairline colour. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-color-accent
entries.reason: Set at runtime from the system accent: ThemeContext.tsx:54 and ThemeContext.tsx:73 call document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--ec-color-accent", ...) with the value of getAccentColor(), and the fallback is ACCENT_COLOR_FALLBACK #007AFF at src/domain/accent_color.ts:4, so the value stays platform-owned (D-04). v5.1 changes the uses, not the value: the accent is never text (accent-as-text moves to the action colour) and ::selection changes its text or fill treatment (white on #007AFF measures 4.01:1), which clears the accent entries 74-04 seals.

entries.name: --ec-color-border
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the book defines no hairline colour. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-color-error
entries.reason: Platform red on icons only (D-04). v5.1 changes the app value #c44536 (the same in both theme blocks, tokens.css:14 and tokens.css:92) to the platform reds per theme and moves error text to the primary text colour, which clears the error-as-text entries 74-04 seals. 74-04 seals no error-icon entry: #c44536 measures 4.56:1 on the light ground #f5f6f8, 4.16:1 on the light surface #e8ecf0, 3.72:1 on the dark ground #141416 and 3.44:1 on the dark surface #1c1c1f (floored), so the icon passes 3:1 on today's grounds in both themes.

entries.name: --ec-color-error-bg
entries.rule: error rows sit on the raised surface step; the error is carried by the platform-red icon and primary-text message (D-04, D-13)

entries.name: --ec-color-gold
entries.reason: Retired (D-05): Bristle Yellow is mark-only and the drop-zone active state uses the platform accent.

entries.name: --ec-color-gold-bg
entries.reason: Retired with --ec-color-gold (D-05): the drop-zone active state uses the platform accent, so the gold tint has no role.

entries.name: --ec-color-hover
entries.reason: Declared in no stylesheet: language_dropdown.css:82 reads var(--ec-color-hover, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)) and always takes the fallback. Hover becomes the surface step (D-06), so v5.1 declares no hover token.

entries.name: --ec-color-info
entries.reason: Declared (#3b7fc4 light, #6ba3d6 dark) and used by no stylesheet or component under src/renderer; no brand token replaces it.

entries.name: --ec-color-muted
entries.reason: Fails the 4.5:1 text bar on every ground it sits on (2.04:1 to 3.08:1 in 74-RESEARCH); v5.1 merges it into the secondary text colour, --ec-color-text-secondary.

entries.name: --ec-color-preserved-bg
entries.reason: v5.1 replaces the green tint on preserved-field rows (rgba(52, 199, 89, 0.08) light, rgba(48, 209, 88, 0.12) dark, tokens.css:21 and tokens.css:99): the preserved field is not cleaned, so it goes neutral (D-02).

entries.name: --ec-color-removed-bg
entries.reason: v5.1 replaces the red tint on removed-field rows (rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.08) light, rgba(255, 69, 58, 0.12) dark, tokens.css:20 and tokens.css:98): colour inside list rows means status (D-02) and no brand token replaces the tint.

entries.name: --ec-color-success
entries.reason: Replaced by the cleaned colour, Steady Teal in light and Seafoam in dark (D-02); the app green #34c759 / #30d158 is not a brand colour, and 74-RESEARCH R-05 measures the light check icon at 2.05:1.

entries.name: --ec-duration-fast
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book gives no hover, pressed or focus feedback duration; the app keeps 150ms (tokens.css:67), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-duration-normal
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book's reveal is about 200 ms and it publishes no duration token; the app keeps 200ms for settle (tokens.css:68), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-duration-slow
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book gives no drawer duration; the app keeps 300ms for the settings drawer only (D-14, tokens.css:69), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-ease-out
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book asks for an ordinary ease-out and publishes no curve value; the spec uses the CSS keyword ease-out, which replaces this app cubic-bezier (D-14, tokens.css:65), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records the keyword.

entries.name: --ec-ease-spring
entries.reason: Retired (D-14): the cubic-bezier overshoots and the brand says nothing bounces in the product; its uses move to the ordinary ease-out.

entries.name: --ec-font-family
entries.reason: System sans stack (D-08, tokens.css:53): BRAND.md says that inside the app the interface keeps the system font, so ExifCleaner feels native; no font file is bundled.

entries.name: --ec-font-family-mono
entries.reason: System monospace stack (D-08, tokens.css:55): BRAND.md permits Geist Mono or the system monospace and the app keeps the system one; no font file is bundled.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-body
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book's type rows are marketing-sized and set no app UI scale; the app keeps 16px for body text (D-09), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-heading
entries.reason: Retired (D-09): declared at tokens.css:60 (24px) and read by no stylesheet or component; v5.1 reintroduces a heading size only if it needs one.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-label
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book sets no app UI scale; today's token is 20px (tokens.css:59, read at settings_drawer.css:71), which the spec calls the title size (D-09) because the name clashes with the 12px Label role, so v5.1 renames it, and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.

entries.decision: The book's type rows are marketing-sized and set no app UI scale; the app keeps 14px as the default UI size (D-09), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.
